title: KU2D YouTube Metadata, Transcript, Comments & Acquisition Pattern v2
objective: In one continuous queue, extend the existing YouTube acquisition design from metadata-only foundations into a durable YouTube content-and-audience acquisition architecture covering metadata, Thai/English transcript or captions only, comments/replies, cross-content semantics, KU2D-to-KU2A dataset contracts, deterministic fixtures/tests, and YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2. Perform Branch Handoff Protocol v1 first, then continue without returning control between phases unless repository integrity or coordination protocol requires fail-closed stop.
instructions: Use Branch Handoff Protocol v1 mechanically: close the source queue before switching, then create/switch to codex/ku2d-youtube-content-acquisition-v2 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at exact merge commit 8056fdae7ff6ba8501fa16b5d5f7605a997a9526 and initialize the target queue as sole authority under KU2D-BH-000009.

Inspect all merged YouTube acquisition policies, schemas, fixtures, tests, results, and source-registry records before editing. Use official Google/YouTube developer documentation for capability research where needed, but do not execute any live YouTube API/content request in this Prompt.

Expand the metadata capability map and contract across channel, playlist, video enumeration, video details, category, duration, language/default-language signals, live/broadcast status where available, statistics, publish/update timestamps, thumbnails, tags/topics where contractually available, and relationship identifiers. Keep observed API fields, derived fields, unavailable fields, and proposal-only fields explicitly distinct.

Design transcript/caption acquisition for Thai and English only using canonical allowed_languages=[th,en]. Do not retain or normalize transcript text in any other language. Other-language tracks may be observed only as availability metadata if needed. Preserve provenance for original, translated, manual, auto-generated, owner-authorized, and public-surface capability classes without conflating them.

Define deterministic transcript track selection precedence when both Thai and English exist and when multiple tracks of the same language exist. Model manual Thai, manual English, auto-generated Thai, auto-generated English, both languages, unsupported-language-only, no captions, captions disabled/unavailable, private/deleted/unavailable video, partial transcript, timestamp gaps, translated track, and owner-authorization-required track. No-transcript and unsupported-language-only must not automatically be extraction failure.

Define a normalized transcript_segment entity with video identity, segment order, start/end or duration when available, text, language, caption kind, source surface/API, acquisition timestamp, provenance, and completeness indicators.

Design commentThreads/comments acquisition including top-level comments, replies, pagination, publishedAt, updatedAt, likeCount where available, exposed author/channel identifiers, moderation/deletion states where observable, edited comments, duplicate observation, and comments-disabled behavior. Separate requested/API ordering from representativeness and never interpret comment count or display order as sentiment or demand.

Define normalized comment and comment_reply entities with stable relationship keys, source provenance, acquisition timestamp, original publish/update timestamps, completeness/coverage indicators, bounded pagination semantics, quota/budget boundaries, and stop conditions.

Encode cross-content semantic rules explicitly: transcript != description; creator speech != viewer opinion; comment count != sentiment; ordering != representativeness; moderated/deleted comments imply potentially incomplete sampling; transcript absence != irrelevance; metadata statistics are observation snapshots, not causal explanations. Keep provenance/authority separate from interpretation.

Define module-level status and Deep Audit semantics, including required, optional, unavailable, owner_authorized_only, public_accessible, evidence_withheld, unsupported_language_only, and comments_disabled where appropriate. Define source-level exit 0/2/1 without treating optional-module absence as a technical failure unless the contract requires that module.

Produce YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2 as Channel Discovery -> Playlist/Video Enumeration -> Metadata -> Thai/English Transcript/Caption -> Comments/Replies -> Normalize -> Provenance -> Quality/Deep Audit -> Dataset Intake. Keep module requirements configurable and fail-closed. Separate official API methods, owner-authorized methods, public transcript surfaces, and non-durable/non-approved methods. Do not approve browser scraping, challenge bypass, auth bypass, or undocumented endpoint dependence.

Define storage-neutral KU2D-to-KU2A entities and relationships for channel, playlist where useful, video, transcript_segment, comment, and comment_reply, including acquisition timestamp, original publish/update timestamps, language, transcript/caption kind, relationship keys, provenance, completeness indicators, module status, and quality/audit fields. Design the contract so KU2A can later perform text analytics, sentiment, topic analysis, semantic search, and temporal analysis without knowing YouTube-specific acquisition logic. Do not implement analytics or ML here.

Add offline fixtures covering metadata, Thai/English transcript cases, comments/replies, pagination, disabled/unavailable content, language filtering, quota boundaries, provenance, Deep Audit, partial acquisition, and failure classifications. Add fail-closed validators and deterministic tests without weakening existing YouTube, supermarket, retail, marketplace, coffee, governance, or handoff regressions.

Produce a final YouTube v2 readiness report stating metadata readiness, Thai transcript readiness, English transcript readiness, comments readiness, owner-authorization dependencies, quota implications, public-read capability, remaining gaps, and the smallest bounded future live pilot required to validate unresolved behavior. Recommend Q-Diving only if supported by repository evidence; do not execute the pilot in this queue.

Do not make live YouTube API/content requests, caption downloads, live comment acquisition, OAuth/owner-authorization flows, browser/Edge acquisition, knowledge-authority promotion, parked-reference mutation, production/store/scheduler action, ML, Survey/DoE/SEM, cleanup, or integration/main mutation. If a phase is blocked, record the blocker and continue remaining offline phases where safe. Stop only for repository-integrity risk, coordination-protocol failure, or inability to preserve fail-closed contracts.
Open/update one PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform, perform safe mechanical PR operations including Ready transition when CI is green where possible, and do not merge.

Return KU2D-R-000034 with completed_queue_summary containing only important items: work completed; key findings/results; repo/knowledge state changes; important out-of-scope actions not performed; remaining blockers/risks; recommended next logical step. Also report metadata/transcript/comments readiness, Thai/English language filtering behavior, official-vs-owner-authorized capability boundaries, pattern v2 status, Dataset Intake status, and the bounded future live-pilot recommendation.

external_research_policy.note: Documentation research may map capabilities, but no live YouTube content/source acquisition is authorized. Unresolved behavior requiring a live API call must be carried forward as a separately governed bounded pilot objective.

completion_behavior.if_phase_blocked: record blocker and continue remaining offline phases where safe
